limitations: Packet represents the supported causal allele, not full background genotype.

patient_identity.statement: The single Japanese girl, age9 atreport, is the source patient.

genotype.statement: Heterozygous R306Q is the supported diseaseallele; the patient additionally carries maternal P152L intrans, omitted frompacket.
limitations: Packet is not a complete genotype record.

segregation.statement: R306Q arose denovo; trioWES supports parentage. Mother and healthy sister carry P152L.

phase.statement: cDNAcloning confirms R306Q and P152L on different alleles; onlyR306Q retained ascausal after functional testing.

causal_confidence.statement: R306Q has reduced DUBactivity and dominantnegative cellular effects; isogenic correction ofR306Q rescues whereas correction ofP152L doesnot.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All encoded signs and two autoantibodynegatives are described. Neonatal label is finer than reported one-month omphalitis onset; packet omits asepticmeningitis,prematurity and steroid/treatment timing.
limitations: Do not interpret transient cytokineelevation as persistent.
